text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer got injured, so I rush her to the infirmary as fast as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Agh… I think I might've really messed up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay, but like, should I rest, though? I mean, I dunno if I'm being reckless, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Everyone else is out there working hard, but here I am just wasting time because I'm in a little bit of pain…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If I let something this small stop me, I dunno if I'll really be able to run as freely as I want during the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's not like I can't move at all, so there's gotta be something I can still do, right? I don't care if it's super light exercise or whatever.
choice_data_list: What you need to do now is rest up so you can run freely later.
…All right. Let's try to keep going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I thought you'd say that… Sorry, things just got real for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It just sucks that I'm so mentally ready to go out there and run, but my body's not up for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer's shoulders droop sadly as she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yesss! All right, better get warmed back up again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: One, two, three—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Owww!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yikes… I must've twisted it too far!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: …Sorry. I think I made things worse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If even simple stretches are painful, her injury must be serious. I tell her to focus on recovery for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm good to go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I should be able to handle some light exercise, no problem! Course, I'll be careful not to make my injury worse!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right! Back to work!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer takes care not to exacerbate her injury and makes it all the way to the end of the light training session.
